content: SQLite WAL mode unsafe on network filesystems (CIFS, NFS, Docker Desktop on Mac/Windows via 9p). Must bind-mount entire data/ directory (not just .db file) to preserve .db-wal and .db-shm coordination. Same-host bind mount on Linux ext4 is safe. Shared memory IPC via mmap requires all processes to coordinate; inconsistent mounts lead to corruption. Monitor .db-wal size; if >100MB and not shrinking, checkpoints failing.
